g.text: Cookies & Click IDs Deep Dive — What Gets Dropped and Why
The technical glue between an ad click and a website conversion
URL PARAMETERS (added to the destination URL on ad click)
FIRST-PARTY COOKIES (set by the tag on the website's domain)
MATCHING AT CONVERSION (how the tag links back to the ad)
Note: cookies and click IDs only work if the tag is on every page the user visits — gaps in coverage break attribution.
Meta also supports server-side CAPI with hashed email/phone for cross-device matching when browser cookies are limited.
